faq.a: The Feria San Bernabe 2031 typically runs for about a week in mid-June, from around 7 to 14 June. Exact dates are confirmed by Marbella town hall a few months prior. The fair includes daytime activities, evening casetas, and a large fairground with rides and concerts.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Feria San Bernabe fairground?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is approximately 6 km (4 miles) from the Feria San Bernabe fairground in Marbella town centre. A taxi ride takes about 10–15 minutes, depending on traffic. This makes it very easy to combine a boat charter with an evening at the fair.

data.body_html:
Marbella's Feria San Bernabe 2031 is the Costa del Sol's biggest summer party, drawing thousands to the streets of Marbella for a week of music, dancing, and celebration. But if you really want to do it in style, skip the crowded casetas for a few hours and take to the sea. Renting a private boat from Puerto Banús is the ultimate way to elevate your Feria experience — think champagne on the flybridge, swimming in crystal-clear coves, and arriving back just in time for the night-time festivities. This guide covers everything you need to know about combining a Marbella Feria San Bernabe 2031 boat rental with the fair, including the best boats, pricing, and insider tips.

Why Rent a Boat During Feria San Bernabe?

The Feria is fantastic, but it can be intense — hot afternoons, packed fairgrounds, and queues for drinks. A boat charter offers a perfect escape. You get:

  • Privacy: Your own floating VIP lounge for up to 12 guests.
  • Swimming: Anchor at Cala del Faro or Cabopino for a dip in the Mediterranean.
  • Sunset views: Watch the sun sink behind La Concha mountain from the water.
  • Convenience: Puerto Banús is just 10 minutes by taxi from the fairground.

With all-inclusive pricing that covers skipper, drinks, and snacks, it's often cheaper than a night out on land — and infinitely more memorable.

  • Tier B (Mangusta 80): €4,719 minimum 4 hours, includes a free jet ski.
  • Other boats: Pricing on request via WhatsApp — no hidden fees.

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don't pay a cent extra.

Best Itineraries for Feria Week

Most Feria boat charters follow one of these routes:

  • Banús → Cabopino → Banús (2–3 hours): Quick swim stop and back in time for the fair.
  • Banús → Cala del Faro → Estepona → Banús (4–6 hours): Lunch at Estepona port, then sunset return.
  • Banús → Sotogrande → Banús (8 hours): Full day with lunch at the exclusive Sotogrande marina.

All routes offer stunning views of the Sierra Blanca mountains and the Marbella coastline.

Feria San Bernabe 2031: What to Expect

The Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's patron saint festival, held in the town centre around the Alameda Park and fairground. Expect:

  • Daytime: Horse parades, flamenco shows, and family-friendly activities.
  • Evening: Casetas (tented bars) with live music, dancing, and local wine.
  • Fairground: Rides, games, and churros stalls.

With a boat rental, you can enjoy the best of both worlds: the serenity of the sea and the energy of the fair.

Pro Tips for a Perfect Feria Boat Day

  1. Book early: Feria week is our busiest period. Reserve at least 2–3 weeks ahead.
  2. Choose the right time: A 16:00–20:00 charter lets you swim in the afternoon sun and arrive at the fair for the night-time party.
  3. Dress smart: Light linens and swimwear for the boat, then change into Feria attire (traje corto or flamenco dress) for the evening.
  4. Stay hydrated: We provide plenty of drinks, but bring extra water for the fair.
  5. Use WhatsApp for custom requests: Want a specific caterer or a DJ on board? Just ask.
